name: 363-hug-parent-kid
notes: #363 B7.d, on in the game since the user's 2026-11-06 call: a parent and their kid hug at dawn or on the evening green now and then (View/HugDirector.cs: HugRules.ParentKidToday, about 1 day in 3 for each part, a pair once a day). They close in with arms wide, wrap (arms x85, z inward 10, squash .92, lean 10), a hit on arrival, hold 1.2 s swaying roll +-6 at 1 Hz (opposite signs: they face each other), step back 0.05 u with a tiny hop, arms drop. The kid is the second and is lifted 0.02 u while held. knownGaps react: the bench only sees a doll answer by style, position or prop; the kid answers by wrapping its arms and squashing on the same frame (pose), after closing in by itself. AnimLab: cheat 'Hug: parent and kid now'.
